title: Ringed pullback kflat
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal C'$ be small sites with sheaves of commutative rings $\mathcal O$ on $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal O'$ on $\mathcal C'$, respectively, let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C')\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, meaning an adjoint pair $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits, and let $c:u^{-1}\mathcal O\to\mathcal O'$ be a map of sheaves of commutative rings. On module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] put $u^*M=u^{-1}M\otimes_{u^{-1}\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Apply $u^*$ termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. If $P$ is a K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] of $\mathcal O$-module sheaves and all its terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $u^*P$ is a K-flat complex of $\mathcal O'$-module sheaves and all its terms are flat. No flatness of $c$ is required.

proof.text: Apply the existing general ringed-topos pullback theorem [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-kflat-pullback] to the given small sites, sheaves of rings, topos morphism u, and ring map c. Its conclusion is exactly that the termwise extension-of-scalars complex u^*P is K-flat over O' and has flat terms; the notation P versus K^bullet is immaterial.

lean.statement: theorem isKFlat_ringedToposPullback {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D] [EssentiallySmall.{w} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} D] {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D} {R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{w}} {S RI : Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{w}} (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type (w))) (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (w))) (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv] (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S) (uStar : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R) ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JD (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S)) (hobj : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R), uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M)) (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)} (a : M ⟶ N), uStar.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm) [uStar.Additive] (P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ) (hP : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients) (hflat : ∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JC) (R := R) (P.X n)) : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients ((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧ ∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JD) (R := S) (((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n)
lean.note: The independently quantified ringed pullback assertion is the same as lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-kflat-pullback after using the general IsFlatOnSite and IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients predicates. The module at the original path reexports that theorem.
